description: Defines the ConnectUdpTunnel class for managing UDP tunnels in a QUIC-based proxy, including connection handling, data reception, and datagram processing.

classes.name: ConnectUdpTunnel
classes.description: Manages a UDP tunnel for a CONNECT-UDP proxy, handling connection setup, data transfer, and stream management.

methods.name: ConnectUdpTunnel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UDP tunnel with request handler, socket factory, server label, and acceptable targets.

methods.name: OpenTunnel
methods.description: Attempts to establish a UDP tunnel to the target server based on request headers.

methods.name: IsTunnelOpenToTarget
methods.description: Checks if the tunnel to the target server is currently open.

methods.name: OnClientStreamClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the client stream is closed.

methods.name: BeginAsyncReadFromTarget
methods.description: Starts asynchronous read from the target socket.

methods.name: OnDataReceivedFromTarget
methods.description: Processes data received from the target.

methods.name: SendUdpPacketToTarget
methods.description: Sends a UDP packet to the target.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an error response with status and details.

methods.name: TerminateClientStream
methods.description: Terminates the client stream with an error.
